description: This file defines the ProcessMonitor class and related structures for managing subprocesses, including starting, stopping, suspending, and resuming processes, as well as handling subprocess commands and monitoring routines within the cuttlefish namespace.

classes.name: MonitorEntry
classes.description: Represents a monitored subprocess, including its command, process, and criticality status.

classes.name: ProcessMonitor
classes.description: Manages subprocesses, including starting, stopping, suspending, and resuming, with thread safety and communication channels.

classes.name: ProcessMonitor::Properties
classes.description: Configuration class for ProcessMonitor, allowing setting restart behavior, commands, and strace options.

methods.name: RestartSubprocesses
methods.description: Sets whether subprocesses should be restarted upon exit.

methods.name: AddCommand
methods.description: Adds a command to be monitored and managed.

methods.name: StraceCommands
methods.description: Specifies commands to be traced with strace.

methods.name: StraceLogDir
methods.description: Sets the directory for strace logs.

methods.name: ProcessMonitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the process monitor with properties and a secure environment file descriptor.

methods.name: StartAndMonitorProcesses
methods.description: Starts all configured subprocesses and begins monitoring them.

methods.name: StartSubprocesses
methods.description: Internal method to start subprocesses based on properties.

methods.name: ReadMonitorSocketLoop
methods.description: Reads from the monitor socket in a loop, handling communication.
